name: How do you handle unexpected issues or changes during a coordinated tile installation project?

mainEntity.name: How do you handle unexpected issues or changes during a coordinated tile installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unexpected issues or changes during a tile installation project are managed through clear communication and proactive problem-solving. Our coordination process includes contingency planning and regular updates with the client. For example, if a subfloor issue is discovered, we would immediately assess it, explain the implications, propose solutions, and adjust the timeline or budget with your approval, minimizing disruptions to your project in Oakland or surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: We manage unexpected issues with clear communication, contingency planning, and proactive solutions, keeping you informed and approved on any changes.
